# robots.txt for linlib.com
# Goal: maximize SEO + AEO discoverability while protecting non-public paths.

# Default policy for all crawlers (search + AI):
# - Crawl all public educational content.
# - Avoid common private/backend paths.
# - Block JSON data endpoints (not public web pages).

Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /login/
Disallow: /wp-admin/
Disallow: /staging/
Disallow: /search-index.json
